model.epochs: a LIST of trusted source epochs, each { epochId, sourceKind, sourceBasis }
model.upgradeBehavior: a legitimate upgrade ADDS an epoch; existing historical associations are not invalidated
model.unknownHistoricalSource: an association whose basis matches NO trusted epoch is refused, never silently treated as verified

sourceVersionChange.reason: the record's stored basis is immutable and compared against the registry; a new deployment epoch does not mutate stored records

tests: P2C C2 §6.1 a record matching no trusted epoch is refused (NO_TRUSTED_EPOCH_MATCHES)
P2C C2 §6.1 historical compatibility — a second epoch admits a historical record without invalidating it
